The '''Jedi chapter house''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] was an [[Jedi academy|academy]] located near the city of [[Rhire]]. It was famed for the education of renowned [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]].

==History==
{{Quote|Nineteen hours ago, we lost contact with the Jedi enclave on Rhinnal. The Republic patrol frigate ''Toron Voq'' went to investigate. The vessel's crew reported the enclave had been slaughtered. No survivors.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="Red Reaper" />}}
The Jedi chapter house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] was built near the gray banks of the [[Frieste River]] when the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rhire]] was only a supply outpost for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorers. The academy was a simple, spired structure that was able to accommodate almost a hundred patients.<ref name="Core">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the enclave was [[Attack on Rhinnal|destroyed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Red Reaper]]''.<ref name="Red Reaper" /> The chapter house was eventually rebuilt, and specialized in educating its students in the art of [[Force healing/Legends|healing]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Expanded over the centuries, it was used continuously over the centuries as well as the [[Jedi Academy (H'ratth)|academy]] on [[H'ratth]].<ref name="TJP" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Vel Ardox]] and [[Noro Zak]] accompanied a wounded [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] to Rhinnal for healing following a particularly nasty fight during her [[Mission to Esseles|mission]] to [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. While Zak and Ardox remained at the facility, Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] stayed on Esseles to pick up the mission Gallia had failed to complete. On Rhinnal communications were knocked out by a storm, causing Jinn and Kenobi to fear the worst. Arriving on Rhinnal, they found everything to be as it should be, and informed their comrades they had discovered the key to their assignment on Esseles: [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] had stolen [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] to attack the [[Corulag Academy]].<ref name="Episode I Adventures 3: The Fury of Darth Maul">''[[Episode I Adventures 3: The Fury of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

Following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal's]] reputation was sufficient enough to spare the academy from being demolished by [[COMPNOR Regiment|COMPNOR fanatics]] unlike many other [[Jedi chapter house/Legends|Jedi chapter houses]] throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Core" />
At the close of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the academy was shut down but not destroyed. Purged of all Jedi-related material by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the academy was spared destruction because of its function as a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] and its use to the native populace.<ref name="Core" /> [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] made a note regarding the Rhinnal chapter house in his stolen copy of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. He remarked that the book itself revealed such locations, saving the Empire time as they hunted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
